pattern_1.transformation: Parse date from 'Collection Date' using format '%Y-%m-%d'. Only a calendar date (no time-of-day) is reported, so timestamps are localized directly to UTC at 00:00. Discrete field campaign (one collection date per plot); is_timeseries = False and interval_min = NA.

Sampling depth is not reported in the staged payload and no package metadata or README is present in the workspace to resolve it; populate with NA. (For the structurally analogous ER TDR survey, dataset 15, the expert used a 25 cm near-surface depth taken from package metadata that is not available here.)
Look up 'Northing' for each 'SampleSiteCode' in NEON_plot_TDR.csv.
